dataset: Earthquake Hazards Program – real-time GeoJSON summary feeds
description: Global earthquake origins (and a few other seismic event types) with magnitude, depth, review status, PAGER alert level and tsunami flag.

coverage.geographic: Global for M4.5+; M2.5+ coverage is densest in the United States and adjacent regions.
coverage.temporal: M2.5+ for the past 7 days and M4.5+ for the past 30 days; older events persist locally until retention expires.

attribution: U.S. Geological Survey, Earthquake Hazards Program

license.name: U.S. Government work – public domain (USGS asks for credit)

limitations: Automatic solutions are preliminary: magnitude and location are routinely revised and events are occasionally deleted.
Outside the United States only events of roughly M4.5 and larger are reliably present.
Feed also carries non-tectonic events (quarry blasts, explosions); they are labelled in the sub-category.
confidenceNotes: Confidence reflects the USGS review status only: 'reviewed' solutions score 0.95, 'automatic' solutions 0.7. Severity is derived by this application from magnitude and the PAGER alert colour.

retention.note: Events are kept for 45 days after they occurred, then purged.

layers.name: Earthquakes (USGS)
layers.description: Seismic events M2.5+ from the past week and M4.5+ from the past month.
